notes.title: The Chinese Localization Update - 中文本地化更新
notes.notes:
Greetings eldritch cultists!

向各位古神的教徒送上问候！

We're just letting you all know that [i][b]Chinese Localization[/b][/i] has been added to [b]Sucker for Love[/b]! And you know what that means? A wider net for potential [i]thral- er I mean followers[/i]! Enjoy!

我们只想告诉大家一则好消息：《爱的吸盘》现已新增中文本地化！您是否了解这句话背后的含义？那便是：让古神的恩泽惠及更多奴隶信众。好好享受游戏吧！

[h3]You can access the localization menu from the bottom-right corner of the Main Menu. 您可以通过主菜单的右下角进入本地化界面。[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327084/b0f9650d3e2eb8bd25737f2b4c1d0599b50af601.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327084/523c63203cf378afb4f39deffa7d313dfe3f54b4.png[/img]

[h3]Both the dialogue and Book texts have been translated! 所有的对话以及书籍内容皆已翻译完成！[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327084/41899f5e73cdcc9acd93e6aa1c9fc7fe24775d50.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327084/0a33f16039fe0112a93c2ca420ff3c471f5b42ce.png[/img]

[i][h2]Don't have the game yet? Pick it up now! 还没购入游戏？现在就剁手吧[/h2][/i]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1574270/Sucker_for_Love_First_Date/

notes.title: Version 1.61 Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Sucker for Love: First Date v.1.61 Patch Notes[/h2]

[u][h3]Issues that have addressed and fixed:[/h3][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed some voice line issues
[*] Fixed candle persistence issue in Chapter 3
[*] Fixed dialogue duplicating if you save/load in the middle of dialogue
[*] ...Among other minor fixes and performance improvements!
[/list]
[h3][u]Additions:
[/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] Contains over [i][b]15[/b][/i] updated sprites!
[/list]

If any issues come up, please feel free to post about it on the discussions board for the game, or join the official [b]DreadXP[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/K264MKJ7pZ]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Version 1.51 Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Sucker for Love: First Date v.1.51 Patch Notes[/h2]

[u][h3]Issues that have addressed and fixed:[/h3][/u]
[list]
[*] The ritual '[i]Final Pledge[/i]' in Chapter 2 crashed the game if it was performed in the bathroom.
[*] [i]'Spirit Scream'[/i] not stopping after they pass
[*] Going outside turns off the music/soundscape during Chapter 3
[*] Enemies still attacking you after you dispel the final Evil and start the final dialogue.
[*] One of the Ending's CG was the wrong size
[*] Some missing dialogue at the end of one of Chapter 2's endings
[*] Disabled light turn off thank you looping forever until I can squash it for real
[*] Robe was being inconsistent during '[i]Dark Communion[/i]' in Chapter 2
[*] ...Among other minor fixes!
[/list]
[h3][u]Additions:
[/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] UI indicator for the CTRL 'skip dialogue' key
[*] Additional Voice Lines for Auntie Nyan Nyan during Chapter 3
[/list]

If any issues come up, please feel free to post about it on the discussions board for the game, or join the official [b]DreadXP[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/K264MKJ7pZ]Discord[/url]!
